blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. on Thursday asked the Department of Transportation (DOTr) to address bottlenecks in the transportation network, citing their impact on the movement of essential goods as the country gears up for the effects of Super El Niño. He made the call during the grand opening of the United Parcel Service (UPS) Clark International Air Hub at Clark International Airport in Pampanga, which is expected to expand cargo-handling capacity and strengthen the country’s logistics network.
